email_body:
Dear Redcare Pharmacy & Farmaline team,

I'm applying for the Account Manager Belgian Market role. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and e-commerce, I've spent the past years helping businesses grow online — from building and optimizing Shopify and WooCommerce stores to analyzing performance data and turning it into actionable insights. I enjoy working with partners to understand their business and find opportunities for growth, and I'm comfortable using KPIs and Excel to identify quick wins and trends.

What draws me to this role is the mix of account ownership and cross-functional projects, plus the chance to explore AI tools to make processes smarter. I work independently, organize my own portfolio, and take ownership of additional projects. I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking), with a willingness to strengthen it further.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your marketplace team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Redcare Pharmacy & Farmaline team,

I'm writing to apply for the Account Manager Belgian Market position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and e-commerce, I've spent the past years helping businesses grow online — from building and optimizing Shopify and WooCommerce stores to analyzing performance data and turning it into actionable insights. I enjoy working with partners to understand their business and find opportunities for growth, and I'm comfortable using KPIs and Excel to identify quick wins and trends.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage client websites, run SEO analyses, and report on performance using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. I've worked on e-commerce projects such as proteinbox.com.tr and Shopify stores harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com, where I handled store design, product catalogues and blog content. This experience has taught me how to translate data into clear recommendations and how to collaborate with clients to achieve their goals. I also enjoy taking ownership of additional projects — for example, I built and optimized mirook.com with structured data and AI search visibility in mind, and I regularly use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows.

What draws me to this role is the mix of account ownership and cross-functional projects, plus the chance to explore AI tools to make processes smarter. I work independently, organize my own portfolio, and take ownership of additional projects. I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking), with a willingness to strengthen it further. I'm comfortable working in an international team and eager to contribute to a mission that makes healthcare more accessible.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your marketplace team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
